title: The Place de l’Hôtel-de-Ville, 31 July 1830, with the arrival of Louis-Philippe, Duc d’Orléans
creator: Pierre-Louis Foulley
relevance: Contemporary three-dimensional representation of the Hôtel de Ville square and buildings, made by an eyewitness of the 1830 event.
limits: This is not a digital 3D scan. It depicts 31 July 1830, not the Paris Commune in 1871. Photos are credited © Pierre Antoine; no open reuse license was verified, so only the museum record is linked.
